Latest release did not end up on zenodo or RSD
The latest release found on zenodo is 0.4.0 (0.5.0 hence wasn't added).
In the RSD I also only found an older version (0.3.1). 

I guess that usually should be done automatically when a release is done, so not sure what went wrong here.

```
find_file "release"

According to the guidelines, to create a release, one needs to check the author list, bump the version using `bump2version`, update the `CHANGELOG.md`, and then draft a new release on the GitHub release page. It also mentions that a GitHub action will run which will publish the new version to anaconda and pypi, as well as make a Zenodo entry for the release.

Given these instructions, it seems that the release process is not fully automated, as one needs to manually draft the release on GitHub. It's possible that the release process failed or was interrupted at some point, which is why the latest release did not make it to zenodo or RSD.
